questions.q: How does 'publishing' in Tableau Next differ from publishing a workbook from Tableau Desktop?
options: Nothing changes; you still upload a workbook file to a server
There is no separate publish step; assets already live in a workspace, and you decide who can access them and where they appear
Tableau Next only allows publishing to Slack
Tableau Next assets can only be viewed by their creator
questions.explain: Assets are built inside a workspace on the Salesforce platform, so the key decisions are sharing, embedding, and templating rather than uploading a file.

questions.q: Which roles are available when sharing a whole workspace in Tableau Next?
options: Viewer or Editor
Only Owner
Only Viewer
Admin or Guest
questions.explain: Workspaces can be shared with a Viewer or Editor role, while other asset types such as dashboards and semantic models are shared with the Viewer role.

questions.q: What is the default state of general access when you create a new Tableau Next asset?
options: Open to everyone in the org as Editor
Open to the public internet
Shared automatically with your manager
Restricted, so only people you share with individually can access it
questions.explain: General access starts restricted; only users or groups you add can open the asset until you change that setting.

questions.q: A user has Viewer access to your workspace but is still not allowed to see certain records in a dashboard. What is the most likely explanation?
options: Tableau Next dashboards never show record-level data
Sharing a workspace does not share the underlying data; data access is governed separately in Data 360
Viewers can only see dashboards created that day
The dashboard must be re-published from Tableau Desktop first
questions.explain: Workspace sharing does not grant access to the data model objects behind the assets. Data space and object and field permissions in Data 360 still apply.

questions.q: Which option lets other teams install a copy of your dashboard design and customize it on their own data?
options: Following the dashboard
Granting general access
Generating a dashboard template
Adding a Viewer to the workspace
questions.explain: Generating a template from an open dashboard packages the design so other teams can install and customize it.
